_doc: Honest competitive comparison. Per docs/A2Z_LIVING_DOCS_PLAN.md Part 3 Rule 1, comparisons cite specific competitor capabilities with URLs/dates rather than vague 'we are better' claims. Honest scope sections distinguish what A2Z does/doesn't do.

what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.explanation: 6-gate defense-in-depth perimeter (G104-G109) means the codebase enforces its own architectural rules. Engineering decisions documented in the charter become permanent invariants — future regressions fail the build. Few banking platforms ship with this discipline.
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.verification: Run python scripts/audit.py on any version and review the gate definitions in scripts/audit.py.
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.honest_scope: This is a discipline pattern, not a unique technology. Other platforms COULD adopt it; A2Z has.

what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.explanation: The platform's stocks (6), feedback loops (15), invariants, and composites are first-class objects in the codebase, not inferred from a relational schema. Per Charter §6 (Meadows: 'a system is its feedback loops').
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.honest_scope: Most banking MIS systems organize around modules + reports. A2Z organizes around stocks + flows + invariants. This is not strictly better; it is a different design choice that produces different operational properties.

what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.claim: 100% feedback-loop coverage with the engine+loop+UI canonical sequence
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.explanation: All 15 designed feedback loops are wired in code. New loops follow a 2-batch + UI-surface sequence (engine batch + closure batch + surfacing batch).
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.verification: utils/system_flows.py — every loop has status: WIRED. The L05 (cards) and L14 (streaming) sequences (v7.12/v7.13 + v8.4/v8.5) are documented examples.
what_a2z_is_genuinely_distinctive_about.honest_scope: 100% of DESIGNED loops are wired. The charter could grow with new loops in v9.x; we have not surveyed every conceivable feedback signal in banking.

alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.category: Core banking system (FLEXCUBE, T24, Finacle, etc.)
alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.explanation: A2Z requires a core banking system; it does NOT replace one. A2Z reads from FLEXCUBE via the ACL.
alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.honest_disclaimer: Banks evaluating A2Z still need their core banking platform.

alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.explanation: A2Z is banking-domain-specific with built-in IFRS engines, BSC pillars, capital adequacy, etc. PowerBI/Tableau are general analytics — they need every domain rule built from scratch.
alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.honest_disclaimer: If a bank wants a generic dashboard tool with custom calculations, BI tools are appropriate. A2Z is appropriate when the bank wants the BANKING DOMAIN baked in.

alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.explanation: A2Z's CRM workflows (pipeline_management.py + page 3_pipeline.py) are A2Z-Blueprint-internal, not a Salesforce replacement.
alternatives_a2z_does_not_attempt_to_rep.honest_disclaimer: Banks deeply invested in Salesforce/Dynamics will use those for CRM; A2Z's pipeline module is for banks without dedicated CRM.

what_a2z_is_NOT_better_at: Multi-process scaling: v8.x is single-process Streamlit. Production multi-tenant deployments need Redis-backed shared state (v9.x roadmap). High-throughput banking platforms like Mambu or Temenos T24 handle scale natively.

Mobile banking customer-facing app: A2Z is internal MIS. It does not provide the customer-facing mobile/web banking experience. Banks need a separate digital banking suite (Backbase, Finastra, etc.) for that.
Payment processing: A2Z does not process payments. It reports on them. Payment processing belongs to the core banking system + payment networks.
Marketing automation: A2Z's campaigns module is internal targeting + tracking. It does not replace marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot).
Card processing: A2Z's cards module (utils/cards.py) provides usage profiling and L05 closure. It does not provide card issuance or transaction authorization.
honest_scope: This document deliberately does NOT name specific competitor products with comparative percentages. Such claims require defensible methodology that A2Z does not have at v8.x.

A2Z's discipline patterns (audit gates, honest acknowledgements, 2-batch canonical sequence) are reproducible by others. The competitive moat is execution of the discipline, not the discipline itself.

Banks evaluating A2Z should treat the 36-batch clean-streak as evidence of execution discipline, not as evidence of feature breadth. Specific feature parity vs Oracle FCUBS Performance Manager or McKinsey Wave requires line-item comparison the bank does itself.
Where the original draft said 'no other banking MIS offers...' — those claims are removed because verifying them would require a market survey A2Z has not conducted.
